answer: Make each agent prove it durably holds a unique data vault. On joining, a node is seeded a large random dataset it must store; the protocol issues random Merkle spot-checks, and only a node physically holding its own distinct bytes can answer in time. Picture honest nodes as an oasis of independent stores climbing a shared trellis of audits: a sybil fleet sharing one disk cannot hold N distinct vaults, so every fake costs real linear storage. Faking means buying terabytes per mask, not minting them free.
